# Table 1. Cohort characteristics

Development cohort: MIMIC-IV-ECHO, analysed studies, by left atrial pressure (2025 ASE). External cohort: EchoXFlow examinations evaluable against elevated E/e′; the dataset carries no demographic or clinical data, so only Doppler measurements are shown. Continuous variables: median (IQR) [n with the value].
